development_decision_reviews.text: {"choice":"Add a higher-priority GenericAlias-specific DataDocumenter route.","gap":"The contract permits either internal documenter routing or content-handling changes but does not prescribe which mechanism should ensure callable GenericAlias objects retain variable documentation.","observable_impact":"During automodule member selection, recognized module-level GenericAlias objects are rendered as data even when they are callable; their directive/header shape remains the existing GenericAlias data shape and source documentation is preserved alongside alias text.","options_considered":["Add a higher-priority GenericAlias-specific DataDocumenter route","Teach FunctionDocumenter to retrieve analyzer variable documentation and generate alias content"],"reason":"A dedicated higher-priority data documenter follows the existing NewType routing pattern and limits the behavior change to recognized module-level GenericAlias objects.","reversibility":"The change is localized to one documenter class and its registration and can be reverted without data migration.","timestamp":"2026-07-20T00:00:00+09:00"}

mutation_review.reason: The delegated coercion mechanism can change denominator dtype and backend behavior, so the contract needed either an approved choice or an explicit delegation boundary constraining those observable effects.

development_decision_reviews.text: {"choice":"Cast the validity mask to integer before the shared reduction.","gap":"The contract requires numeric accumulation of boolean weights in the shared denominator path but delegates the exact coercion mechanism.","observable_impact":"Casting the validity mask to integer preserves non-boolean weight dtypes while ensuring boolean-by-boolean dot products accumulate numerically.","options_considered":["Cast the validity mask to integer before the shared reduction","Cast boolean weights to integer before the shared reduction","Multiply weights by integer one before the shared reduction"],"reason":"Casting the boolean validity mask or casting/multiplying the weights are both reasonable local fixes, but they can produce different denominator dtypes and backend behavior.","reversibility":"The change is isolated to one internal denominator operand and can be reverted without changing the public API or general dot semantics.","timestamp":"2026-07-19T22:19:45Z"}
